Part I : Sec. (I) - GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA - 17.09.2025
UNDER  Section  6(1)  of  the  Land  Development  Ordinance,  Mr.  Lansakarage  Don  Nishan  Sudath  Deepakumara  is
appointed as a Land Officer for Kurunegala and Puttalam Districts with effect from 15.10.2009 in addition to the duties
of his post. This appointment will be in effect until he serves in the said post and if he had been previously appointed as a

column1: Land Officer for another province or district/s, it shall be thereby cancelled.
